description: 10-channel universal multipoint indicator: channel inputs, alarm and relay status, input, alarm and retransmission settings per channel
source: DLG DLGTools 2.0 software manual, rev. A08/07 (Portuguese), Tabela Modbus DM-310/V2

sources.title: Software DLGTools 2.0 – Manual de usuário
sources.note: linked in issue #447; DM-310/V1/V2 chapter and its Modbus table

notes: The manual lists the registers as 40001 on with an offset column from 0; the map uses the offset, as sent on the wire. Reserved rows are left out.
Per-channel blocks are 16 registers apart but hold 10 channels; the input block 40001 to 40016 has room for the 16-channel DM-310-16, which has its own table in the same manual.
The manual gives only the register list: it does not give the codes of the sensor types, baud rates, parity, alarm conditions or retransmission types, nor the value ranges.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
